### Observed differences

- A01 changed from an early to a late activity. In the earlier window its mean relative position was about 0.26 (half of the cases at or before roughly the first sixth of the trace); in the later window it is about 0.65 (median about 0.67), with a slightly narrower spread. [POS001]
- The order between A01 and each of the other main activities reversed. Earlier, A01 came before A05 in about 80 in 100 traces, before A06 in about 91, before A07 in about 68, before A02 in about 55 and before A04 in about 49. In the later window, A04 and A07 each precede A01 in all 200 traces, A02 in about 81 in 100, A05 in about 63 in 100, and A06 in about 49 in 100 (previously 9 in 100). [REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005]
- Flows into A01 appeared: A07's outgoing transitions to A01 rose from about 18% to about 68%, and A06's from about 5% to about 15%; A02, A05 and A06 now reach A01 within five steps in about 162, 126 and 97 of 200 traces (previously 91, 39 and 18). A04 reaches A01 within five steps in all 200 later traces (from 103) but no longer immediately. [DIR006, DIR005, LAG005, LAG017, LAG023, LAG011, LAG028]
- A01's own exits were redirected toward A03: about 47% of its outgoing transitions now go to A03 (previously about 7%), while transitions to A02 fell to about 12% (from 29%) and those to A04 and A07 were no longer observed. The A01→A03 pair occurs within five steps in all 200 later traces (about 143 before) and immediately in about 47% of them (about 10% before). [DIR001, LAG002]
- The earlier direct step A07→A03 disappeared (about 28% of A07's transitions before, no longer observed after), so A03 is now typically reached via A01 rather than directly from A07. [DIR006, LAG030]
- Secondary shifts consistent with the above: A02, A04, A05, A06 and A07 each sit slightly earlier in relative position (e.g., A07 mean about 0.52 → 0.42, A02 about 0.31 → 0.23), and A01's old forward pairs thinned out (A01→A02 within five steps in 38 of 200 later traces vs 109; A01→A05 74 vs 161; A01→A06 103 vs 182). Every activity tracked by position still occurs in essentially all traces in both windows. [POS002, POS003, POS004, POS005, POS006, LAG001, LAG003, LAG004]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that A01 was repositioned from an early stage to a late stage of the case: it now runs after A02, A04, A05, A06 and A07 and typically directly before A03, whereas previously it ran near the start and the flow reached A03 without it (A07 led straight to A03 in about 28% of its transitions). The order reversals are observed directly for all five pairs, A01's position distribution moved from the first third to about two-thirds into the case, and the routing and distance changes line up with the same picture (A07 feeds A01 in about 68% of its transitions; A01 leads to A03 in about 47%, immediately in about half of those). Because all activities involved occur in essentially every trace in both windows and the direction, position, relation and lag items agree, a sampling fluctuation is an unlikely explanation. Limitations: positions are event positions within the case, not clock times, so this concerns order rather than timing; and the evidence cannot rule out that only part of the flow changed — about 19 in 100 later traces still show A01 before A02, so a shift in the mix of variants is an alternative to a uniform repositioning of A01. [POS001, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, DIR001, DIR006, LAG002]

Other differences: none of substance outside this restructuring; pairs not involving A01 kept their order shares within a few percentage points (for example A02 before A05 about 75% vs 76%, A07 before A06 about 70% vs 69%). [REL007, REL012, REL013]
